inspiration: Lair as a unit: a camp or herd is one table with its own roster (npc_lair, 1,825 files, named by camp or herd). Idea: a camp is a landmark with a small roster, not a random spawn. Recreate with our own camp layouts and rosters.

Five-tier dungeon loot: each dungeon has one loot table with five levels (datatables/loot/dungeon/tables.txt line 4). Idea: a visible five-step climb per dungeon. Recreate with our own tier names and rarity colour.
Region spawn types: spawn types split per region (spawning/ground_spawning/types, 716 files; tatooine 243). Idea: region-scoped spawn tables feeding the walk-density numbers (row 23 zone population).
Paired quest tables: a quest list and its tasks sit in matching table sets (1,640 each). Idea: keep quest tasks in their own table that points to the list. Recreate with our own schema.

Palette swatches keyed by feature: 32 palette images with a feature prefix (built/game/palette, pc_eye_* family) give colour variation without new models. Idea: one palette per feature family, the same one-model/many-skin idea as the Core3 hue list. Recreate with our own ramps.
